sand-ambush.desc: horn tips and eyes showing in the sand, the sand bulging, the head erupting open-mouthed in a spray, sand raining back

arrow-head.desc: a broad arrowhead viper head pointing out with glowing heat pits that rears, strikes with the fangs out and drips venom

slow-swallow.desc: a long python with the fat lump of a meal sliding slowly down its body

brine-scute.desc: three keeled bony scutes rising off a grey-green back, salt crystals glittering on the keels

log-mimic.desc: a log drifting on the water line, bark grain and a cut end; then two eyes open on it and sink again

theme.notes: Grass snake of meadows and ponds: olive with a bright yellow and black collar behind the head; a strong swimmer, harmless, it sprays a foul musk and, if that fails, plays dead belly up with its tongue lolling. Bobs in like floating.

Grey heron of wetland and coast: a tall grey wader with a white face, a black stripe running back into a trailing plume and a yellow dagger bill; it stands for ages on one leg in the shallows, wades with slow high steps, then shoots its S neck out to spear a fish, and flies off on slow bowed wings with its neck folded and legs trailing. It steps up stride by stride; a bill click when it strikes, a harsh croak when it guards.
Mischief monkey of the rainforest: brown with a peach face, swings by its tail, steals hats and pockets, throws fruit and pulls faces at you.
Red fox: russet coat and a huge white-tipped brush; sly, quick, a mousing hop; the tail is the thing you see as it slips away.
Raccoon of forest and wetland: a grey bandit with a black mask and ringed tail; clever little hands pry lids, grab loot and raid bins.

Tawny owl of forest and mountain woods: round head with no ear tufts, dark eyes in a pale facial disc, warm brown barred plumage; flies without a sound on fringed wings, hoots twit-twoo, and the wood mice freeze when it is about. Floats onto its spot like a moth.
Arctic fox in its white winter coat: curls into a ball in the snow with its tail over its nose, vanishes in a whiteout, dives head-first into drifts.

creatures.name: Tundra Fox
creatures.art: brown summer coat, thin, no snow

theme.notes: Tundra fox in its thin brown summer coat, no snow: lean and quick, mousing for lemmings in the thawing tussocks, coat full of seed burrs.
Badger: grizzled grey back, black-and-white striped face, huge spade claws; digs in, lives in a sett, bashes back.

Mire toad of the wetland: a fat teal-green toad with warts and yellow poison glands, slick with slime, that belly-flops into the bog, breathes swamp gas and catches flies on a sticky pink tongue. It rises slow and wet; squish on the strike, a croak on guard and heal.

The grown-up tide crab squire: a sea-blue shore crab knight in shell plate mail that fences with its slender claw like a rapier, jousts down the beach and throws down its gauntlet to call a duel. Slides in sideways like a crab fencer.

Moss golem of forest, rainforest and mountain: a body of grey stones under a thick green moss cushion, spore stalks with brown capsules nodding on top; it punches with boulder fists and grows its moss back. It heaves up out of the forest floor.

creatures.name: Lichen Golem

theme.notes: Lichen golem of the mountains: a small body of loose scree held together by a flaky grey-green lichen crust, pixie-cup lichens drinking the rain; it tumbles like scree and sheds sharp crusted flakes. It rolls in like a falling stone.

creatures.name: Coral Golem

Bramble wolf of the forest: a grey-green wolf grown through with bramble canes, red-tipped hooked thorns in its fur; it hunts in a pack and howls.

creatures.name: Coconut Crab Youngster

theme.notes: A half-size blue-purple coconut crab still learning the trade: wears a coconut husk on its head like a hat that keeps slipping over its eyes, practises its pinch on nuts that will not crack and works the night shift on the beach. Rolls in, clumsy.

creatures.name: Marsh Harrier
creatures.art: low brown body, pale head, long narrow wings

theme.notes: Marsh harrier of wetland and grassland: low brown body, pale cream head and shoulders, long narrow wings held in a shallow V; it quarters low over the reedbeds tilting side to side, drops its long yellow legs to rake prey out of the reeds, and folds into them to hide. Slides in low from the side.

creatures.name: Moray Lurker
creatures.art: mottled green-brown, jaws out of a rock crack

theme.notes: Moray lurker of coast and island reefs: a mottled green-brown moray that lives with only its head out of a rock crack, mouth opening and closing as it breathes, a hidden second jaw in its throat, tough scaleless leather skin. It comes up out of the rock from below; teeth click on the strike, a hiss when it guards.

Delta gharial of the river wetlands: an olive-tan gharial with a thin snout ending in the ghara, the pot-shaped knob that buzzes and blows bubbles; it drifts among the floating logs looking like one and naps on the sandbars. It bobs up as if floating; a bubbly buzz on the strike, a pop on guard and heal.

Emerald python of the rainforest: vivid green with a row of white flecks down the back, it rests saddled over a branch in loose coils with its head in the middle, hangs down to strike with long front teeth and drops like a rope. Hangs above its spot, then drops.
Jungle tiger of the forest and rainforest: orange with black stripes, slinking low through dappled leaf shade, freezing, then the pounce; the stripes are both its picture and its hiding place.
Cloud (clouded) leopard of the mountain forests: tawny-grey with big dark-rimmed cloud blotches, a very long thick ringed tail; it hangs from branches and rock ledges and comes and goes like mist.

Reef turtle of the islands: a hawksbill with overlapping amber tortoiseshell scutes and a pointed hooked beak for picking sponges off the coral; it flies over the reef on its front flippers, sleeps wedged under ledges and cries salt tears. It hangs above the spot like over a reef and settles; a tink on the strike, a pop on guard and heal.

creatures.name: Dune Wyrmling
creatures.art: barn-length, pale sand colour, thin long fangs

theme.notes: A young sand wyrm the length of a barn, pale as the dunes, that swims through the sand and breaches in humps; thin long needle fangs drip venom. Rises out of the ground onto its spot.

Bog pike of the wetland: a long olive pike with rows of pale bean spots and flat duck-bill jaws full of backward teeth, lying motionless among the reeds and then striking like a torpedo; bog folk say it grabs boots. It crouches and pounces; jaws click on the strike, a pop of bog water when it guards.

A gila monster grown to dragon size in the desert: pink and black bead scales, a fat stored-fat tail, a heavy head that bites, clamps on and grinds venom in rather than striking. Slow, stubborn, never lets go. Lands heavy with a shake.
Cliff ram of the mountains: pale fleece, two thick curled horns, sure cloven hooves on narrow ledges; it rears back and butts with a crack that echoes. Leaps onto its ledge.
Grumpy wolverine of the tundra: a squat dark-brown face with a pale headband, permanently cross, shaggy coat with a pale side band; never backs down.

Wild boar of forest and grassland: bristly brown-black, a bristle crest, ivory tusks that hook upward; roots up turf with its snout, wallows in mud, charges head-down. It comes up out of the ground like it is rooting.

Pelican parliament of coast and island: a crowd of big white pelicans with long yellow bills, orange throat pouches and black wing tips, who scoop fish in their pouches, stand shoulder to shoulder, fly in long lines and decide everything by committee with bills raised like hands. They plop down from a height like a diving pelican; the pouch squishes, the bills clack.
Beaver foreman of the wetland: brown fur, orange chisel teeth and a flat scaly tail it slaps on the water; it gnaws logs, builds the dam and calls its crew.
Giant anteater of the rainforest: a long thin snout, a sticky tongue, huge foreclaws it walks on folded, and a banner of a tail it sleeps under like a cloak.

Giant bumblebee of grassland and forest: a huge round furry bee with a yellow band, a black band and a white tail, wings far too small for it, orange pollen baskets on its legs; it bumbles about and bumps into things. It hovers before it settles.
Tufted lynx of the forest and mountain: tawny, white side ruffs, long black ear tufts that twitch, a bobtail, long hind legs for the spring and a hooked claw.

A mottled clam that lies half buried in the coast sand, opening a crack to peer out with rows of blue mantle eyes and snapping shut on whatever steps near; spits, slimes and pulls with the undertow. Rises out of the ground.

creatures.name: Giant Clam
creatures.art: cart-sized, ridged grey shell, wide pale mouth

theme.notes: A cart-sized island clam with wavy ridged grey valves and a wide pale mouth of glossy teal mantle; it never moves, it just claps shut with a boom that sends the water running. Drops onto its spot with a splash ring.

Desert tortoise: a high dome of scutes with growth rings, elephant legs, a horny beak that crunches cactus; it digs burrows with shovel forelegs, stores water and waits months for rain. Very slow, very heavy landing.

Griffon vulture of mountain and desert: pale buff body, dark flight feathers, a white downy ruff round a long bare neck and a pale bald head; they circle patiently in kettles on thermals, plunge their necks into carcasses, hiss and squabble, then sit gorged and dozing. Lands slow and heavy.
Black bear of forest and mountain: glossy black fur, tan muzzle; rakes bark with four claws, rears up to look big, licks honey and bluff-charges.

Salt sea lion of the coast: a sleek caramel sea lion crusted with sea salt, loud and playful, barking, rolling in the surf, flopping on its belly and bouncing a ball off its nose in the bay. It bounces in; barks chirp on the strike, a wet squish when it guards.
Glacier bear: a rare silver-blue bear of ice fields; huge paws crack the glacier blue, its roar calves ice, its long shadow lies over the snow.

creatures.name: Ice Bear
creatures.art: rimed white-blue fur, icicles on chin

theme.notes: Ice bear of the tundra: rimed white-blue fur and an icicle beard on its chin; it smashes floes, belly-slides on the ice and breathes fog.

Prairie bison of the grassland: a brown herd animal with a high hump and low head, short black horns, a beard; the herd stampedes in a rolling dust cloud and huddles in a wall of wool. It slides in low like a herd arriving.

Dunegrass camel of the desert: one sandy hump that stores water, long legs with splayed two-toed feet, heavy-lidded eyes and long lashes, unimpressed; it spits cud and kicks. Ships of the desert sway as they arrive.

Lichen reindeer of the tundra and mountains: a grey-fawn reindeer whose long rack is crusted with grey-green lichen, a brow shovel over the muzzle, a pale neck ruff; it paws craters in the snow to reach the lichen it lives on, the herd wheels in a circle when pressed, and it holds a grudge. It steps up like a herd on the march.

creatures.name: Caribou Bull
creatures.art: dark brown, velvet antlers, thick neck mane

theme.notes: Caribou bull of the tundra: dark brown with a thick pale neck mane and a huge rack in velvet (two sweeping beams, a brow shovel), shedding strips of velvet in the rut; its knees click as it walks.

creatures.name: Black Jaguar
creatures.art: jet black, faint rosettes, yellow eyes

theme.notes: Black jaguar of the rainforest: jet black so that only the yellow eyes show, faint rosettes surfacing in the sheen of the coat; it drops out of the branches in the rain and kills with one crunching bite.

creatures.name: Goliath Frog
creatures.art: huge, sandy brown, wide flat head

theme.notes: Goliath frog of wetland and rainforest rivers: the biggest frog of all, sandy brown with a wide flat head and thick granular skin; it leaps huge distances, swallows crabs whole (pressing its eyes down to push them in) and shoves river stones into nest pools. It lands heavy with a thud; thud on the strike, a croak on guard and heal.

creatures.name: Frigatebird
creatures.art: black, forked tail, red throat pouch

theme.notes: Frigatebird of island and coast: a glossy black sea pirate on long crooked wings with a deep forked tail and a red throat pouch the male blows up like a balloon; it hangs on the storm wind for days, then swoops on other seabirds until they drop their fish and snatches the fish in mid-air. It hangs above before it drops; the swoop whirrs, the balloon pops.

creatures.name: Emperor Scorpion
creatures.art: glossy black, thick claws, pale glow

theme.notes: Emperor scorpion of desert and rainforest: huge, glossy black, with thick knobbly claws and a curled tail; under moonlight its armour glows pale blue-green, so every glyph is black with a glowing outline. Shy, it scuttles sideways, and many of them crowd together.

creatures.name: Gorse Beast
creatures.art: yellow flowers, dense spines, bee-heavy

theme.notes: Gorse beast of grassland and forest: a shaggy heap of dense green spines covered in yellow pea flowers that smell of coconut and hum with bees; gorse burns hot and its seed pods crack open in the sun. It trundles in slow and heavy.

creatures.name: Goliath Heron
creatures.art: chestnut and grey, very tall, heavy beak

theme.notes: Goliath heron of the wetlands: the biggest heron, very tall, chestnut head and neck with a streaked white throat, a grey back and a huge heavy dark bill; it stands in the shallows longer than anything else, so long a dragonfly lands on its bill, then drives that bill in and swallows big fish whole. It rises slow and heavy; the strike cracks, the guard is a deep croak.

creatures.name: Mandrill Boss
creatures.art: blue and red face, orange beard

theme.notes: Mandrill boss of the troop: red nose ridge, blue ridged cheeks, an orange beard and huge canines; it glares, yawns to show its fangs, drums its chest and charges.

creatures.name: Silver Fox
creatures.art: black fur tipped silver, thin pale legs

theme.notes: Silver fox of the mountains: black fur with every hair tipped silver, thin pale legs; wary, slinking low, and it takes its tithe.

creatures.name: Crab-eating Raccoon
creatures.art: dark mask, wet fur, crab in paw

theme.notes: Crab-eating raccoon of coast and mangrove: a browner, wet-furred bandit with a dark mask and a red crab in its paw; it dunks, washes and cracks its catch.

creatures.name: Eagle Owl
creatures.art: orange eyes, big ear tufts, mottled brown

theme.notes: Eagle owl of mountain crags and forest: the biggest owl, mottled brown, two great ear tufts like horns and blazing orange lamp eyes; a deep BOO-hoo with a white throat puffing; it drops from a ledge onto prey. Crouches and leaps onto its spot.

creatures.name: Old Brock
creatures.art: grey-white face, scarred snout, old and wide

theme.notes: Old Brock: a wide old badger with a grey-white face and a scarred snout, tough-hided; keeps the old sett and charges toll on the path.

creatures.name: Elder Mire Toad
creatures.art: mossy back, huge warts, half-closed eyes

theme.notes: Elder mire toad of the wetland: an ancient, enormous toad with moss growing on its back, huge warts and heavy half-closed eyes; it hardly moves, belches foul gas, mutters in the bog and hides in the marsh fog. It rises very slow and heavy; a deep croak on the strike, a hiss of fog on guard and heal.

creatures.name: Tide Crab Paladin
creatures.art: barnacle armour, one raised claw banner

theme.notes: A teal island tide crab in barnacle armour that holds one claw up as a banner pole: a holy shore warrior with a haloed pincer, a hooked shield and spiked pauldrons. Lands heavy like a knight in full plate.

creatures.name: Peat Golem
creatures.art: dark brown peat body, reed hair, steam

theme.notes: Peat golem of the wetlands: a dark brown body of cut peat turves full of root threads, a hair of reeds with brown seed heads, steam breathing out of its cracks; it heaves wet fists out of the bog and slumps into a wall. It arrives slow and wet.

creatures.name: Elder Bramble Wolf
creatures.art: grey muzzle, thick thorn ruff, scarred

theme.notes: Elder bramble wolf: grey muzzle, scarred, wearing a thick living ruff of green thorns that drains strength from what it catches; old, slow, wily.

creatures.name: Alligator Snapper
creatures.art: spiked shell, pink tongue lure, weed coat

theme.notes: Alligator snapper of the wetland and coast: a huge turtle with a three-keeled spiked shell and a coat of weed, lying still on the bottom with its jaws wide open, wiggling a pink worm-shaped tongue lure until a fish swims in, then a crushing hooked beak. It rises up out of the mud; the beak cracks, a wet squish on guard and heal.

creatures.name: Conger Brute
creatures.art: thick grey eel, shipwreck rust and weed

theme.notes: Conger brute of the coast: a thick grey conger eel living in a shipwreck, streaked with rust and draped in weed, coming out through a porthole, slimy and draining. It lands slow and wet; the wreck cracks on the strike, a slimy squish when it guards and heals.

creatures.name: Red Stag
creatures.art: red-brown coat, wide antlers, autumn bracken

theme.notes: Red stag of forest and mountain in the autumn rut: a red-brown coat, a shaggy neck, a wide royal rack with crowned tops; it bellows with breath steaming, clashes antlers and hides in golden bracken. It lands heavy, and the bellow (croak arcs) is its sound.

creatures.name: Lammergeier
creatures.art: orange chest, black beard, long wedge tail

theme.notes: Lammergeier, the bearded vulture of the high crags: rust-orange chest from bathing in iron mud, a black beard of bristles, red eye ring, long narrow wings and a long wedge tail; it carries bones high and drops them on the rocks to shatter, then eats the marrow. Lands heavily.

creatures.name: Saltwater Gharial
creatures.art: grey-green, salt crust, very long snout

theme.notes: Saltwater gharial of coast and wetland: a big grey-green crocodilian with a salt crust on its scutes and a very long thin snout lined with needle teeth, swept sideways through the water to catch fish; it lies for hours with only its eyes above water and spins in a death roll. It slides in low off the bank; teeth click on the strike, a hiss when it guards.

creatures.name: Rock Python
creatures.art: grey-brown blotches, sun-warm, thick as a barrel

theme.notes: African rock python of grass and hills: grey-brown blotches, thick as a barrel, basking sun-warm on boulders; sits and waits, senses warm prey with heat pits in its lips, strikes open-mouthed and squeezes. Slowest, heaviest landing.

creatures.name: Elder Tiger
creatures.art: greying stripes, old scars, huge paws

theme.notes: Elder tiger: an old tiger with greying, faded stripes, old scars and huge paws; slower than the jungle tiger, it hits harder, licks its wounds back closed and fakes a limp.

creatures.name: Ghost Leopard
creatures.art: pale grey, faint rosettes, near invisible

theme.notes: Ghost leopard of the high mountains: pale grey with faint rosettes, nearly invisible against snow and rock; you see half a rosette in the mist, frost in its fur, and prints in the snow with nothing making them.

The olive mangrove crab grown into a king: holds court under the arching prop roots of the mangrove in a little gold crown, wears mud as armour and snatches from the mire. Steps up in a stately procession.

creatures.name: Mangrove Crab Emperor
creatures.art: gold-edged shell, mangrove root crown

theme.notes: The mangrove king's elder: a vast gold-edged crab wearing a crown of living mangrove roots, drinking brine as a tonic and cloaking itself in roots. Trundles in slowly with all its weight.

The mother of the sand vipers: a heavy horned viper whose live-born brood peeks out of her coils and follows her sidewinding in a file; she ambushes from under the sand with a broad arrowhead and heat pits. Slides in sideways.
Honey badger brute: a low black body under a silver cape, utterly fearless; it charges anything, shrugs off bee stings and twists inside its loose skin.

Thunder yak of the high mountains: a huge black shaggy yak with a long skirt of hair and wide pale horns, so charged with mountain storms that static crackles off its horns and coat; its charge comes with a lightning bolt.

creatures.name: Musk Ox
creatures.art: long dark skirt of wool, horn boss

theme.notes: Musk ox of the tundra and mountains: a long dark skirt of guard hair over soft qiviut underwool, a pale horn boss across the brow with horns hooking down and out; the herd forms a ring, horns out, and enrages when pressed.

Reef eel lord of coast and island: a vivid blue ribbon eel with a yellow jaw, a yellow fin and flared nostril flags, lord of a pink coral castle, taking a toll of every fish that passes; its bite carries a shock. It glides in low over the reef; sparks zig on the strike, a bubble pop when it guards.

creatures.name: Reef Eel Tyrant
creatures.art: huge, banded grey-gold, crown of spines

theme.notes: Reef eel tyrant of the coast: a huge eel banded grey and gold, a crown of spines round its head, ruling the reef by force; it gnaws the coral, rides the hard currents and regrows by sipping from the polyps. It lands heavy; the reef cracks on the strike, a hiss when it guards.

creatures.name: Alpha Dingo
creatures.art: sandy ginger, scarred ear, thick neck ruff

theme.notes: Alpha dingo of the desert: sandy ginger with a thick neck ruff and a torn, scarred ear; leads the pack, howls the signal, picks up burrs in its coat.

Fern cassowary of forest, rainforest and island: a huge flightless bird whose hair-like plumage is a cloak of drooping fern fronds, with a bright blue neck, red wattles, a tall horn casque and a long dagger claw on the inner toe; it butts with the casque, kicks with the dagger, crouches unseen in the ferns and dashes through the undergrowth. It lands heavy with a shake; the kick thuds, the guard is a low hiss.

Deep octopus of island and coast drop-offs: a deep red octopus with long curling arms lined with pale suckers, a hidden parrot beak, ink jets and skin that flashes through stripes, spots and bumps to mimic anything. It bobs up as if floating; a wet squish on the strike, a pop when it guards.

creatures.name: Kraken Spawn
creatures.art: dark purple, small kraken arms, storm ink

theme.notes: Kraken spawn of the stormy coast: a young kraken, dark purple, with small but thick hooked tentacles, a round toothed maw, a hooded mantle with a pale storm eye and storm ink that flickers with lightning. It drops in from above with a splash; thunder cracks on the strike, a squish when it guards.

creatures.name: Giant Otter Gang
creatures.art: dark brown, cream throat, five otters

theme.notes: Giant otter gang of wetland and rainforest rivers: five dark brown giant otters, each with its own cream throat blotch, standing up out of the water to look (periscoping), screaming, mobbing together, slapping fish about and piling on. They converge as a gang; screams chirp on the strike, a click of teeth when they guard.

creatures.name: Leatherback
creatures.art: black ridged shell, white spots, huge flippers

theme.notes: Leatherback of island and coast: the giant sea turtle with no hard shell, a black leathery carapace with seven ridges and white spots, enormous front flippers it rows like oars; it dives deeper than any turtle and lives on jellyfish, swallowed past a throat full of spines. It rises floating and swaying as if swimming; flipper whirr on the strike, a pop on guard and heal.

creatures.name: Ibex Patriarch
creatures.art: huge curved horns, grey-brown, beard

theme.notes: Ibex patriarch of mountain and desert cliffs: grey-brown, a long pale beard, huge backswept scimitar horns ridged with knobs; leaps from crag to crag and stares the herd into line.

creatures.name: Bearded Pig
creatures.art: long pale beard, pointed snout, grey-brown

theme.notes: Bearded pig of the rainforest and swamp: grey-brown, a long pointed snout and a long pale beard; it ploughs the mud, follows the nut and fruit falls and bristles up its back.

creatures.name: Albatross
creatures.art: white, black wing tips, huge wingspan

theme.notes: Albatross of island and coast: a big white seabird with a pink hooked bill and the longest, narrowest wings of all, tipped black; it dynamic-soars over the waves for days without a flap, sleeps on the wing, rests riding the swell, snatches squid off the surface at night and lands clumsily. It glides in low with a streak; the bill clacks, the wings whirr.

creatures.name: Aardvark
creatures.art: pale pink-grey, long ears, tube snout

theme.notes: Aardvark: pale pink-grey, long ears and a tube snout; it digs burrows fast, smashes termite mounds and snuffles out ants.

creatures.name: Snow Lynx
creatures.art: pale grey, huge snowshoe paws, ear tufts

theme.notes: Snow lynx of the mountain and tundra: pale grey, ear tufts, and huge furry snowshoe paws that press and sink, puffing snow; it hides under drifts and drains the warmth out of its prey.

creatures.name: Spurred Tortoise
creatures.art: dry yellow shell, three leg spurs, stout

theme.notes: Spurred tortoise of dry grass and desert: a stout dry-yellow shell with a serrated rim and a forked gular horn under the chin, three big conical spurs on each thigh; males ram each other. Lands hard and fast for a tortoise.

creatures.name: Condor
creatures.art: black, white wing bands, bald red head

theme.notes: Andean condor of the high mountains: huge flat black wings with a white band and fingered tips, a white ruff and a bald wrinkled red head; it soars for hours on thermals without a beat, then drops. Hangs above its spot before it lands.

creatures.name: Sloth Bear
creatures.art: shaggy black coat, pale chest V, long claws

theme.notes: Sloth bear: a shaggy black coat with a pale chest V, long ivory claws for hooking, and a tube snout that hoovers termites with a loud huff.

creatures.name: Elephant Seal Bull
creatures.art: huge grey-brown, swollen nose, scarred neck

theme.notes: Elephant seal bull of coast and island: a huge grey-brown bull with a swollen trunk of a nose that inflates when it roars, a neck and chest calloused and pink with scars from fights, rolls of blubber; it rears up and slams its chest down on rivals. It hauls itself in very slowly and heavily; the roar booms on the strike, a thud when it guards.

creatures.name: Wood Bison
creatures.art: dark shaggy hump, snow on shoulders

theme.notes: Wood bison of forest and tundra: a dark shaggy hump with snow lying on its shoulders; it shrugs the snow off and ploughs through drifts head-down. It drops into the snow and a white ring splashes out.

creatures.name: Wild Bactrian
creatures.art: two humps, thick wool, tough grey-brown

theme.notes: Wild bactrian of desert and mountain: two humps, thick grey-brown wool that moults in clumps, tough and spiteful, draws on its humps to recover; walks in a rolling caravan gait.

creatures.name: Glass Wyrm
creatures.art: glassy, translucent scales, long body

theme.notes: A long desert wyrm whose scales have fused to glass where lightning struck the sand: you see through its body, only the outline and a light glint, rainbows inside. Slides in low, sun-slow until it warms.
